summary: Not assessable in the shed. porch_deck_prop.gd builds no geometry: _build_visual creates two AudioStreamPlayer3D emitters (a creak and a board thud) and the script's only behaviour is a 25-60 s wind-creak loop and the accent-driven knock. The five decks the player sees are baked by the layout pass into the floor shells, so a modelling or texturing change to the deck is a gen_layout and Blender change, not a prop change, and the interaction matrix rules the decks ambient architecture with no per-deck verb.
modelling: Nothing in this script. If the baked decks need work (the reference for a 1928 six-storey Queens walk-up is an iron fire escape with slatted balcony and drop ladder, not a timber deck; the notes record this as a ruled fiction choice), it is a gen_layout shell task and belongs in the floor-shell review, not here.

Warehouse registration: either supply a warehouse_variants() entry that instantiates a short stand-in deck section so the emitter's placement can be judged against the audible source, or exclude the kind from PROP_SCRIPTS inspection so the shed stops showing an empty plinth.
not_reopened: PROP_SET_INTERACTION_MATRIX.md section 7: the five decks stay ambient architecture with no per-deck E verb.
building_root.gd OUTSIDE_HALF_X 14.2 / OUTSIDE_HALF_Z 10.2: the decks stay outside the masonry shell; do not move them inward.
